The console front is visible but the exact model label (PS4 Pro vs other) and any serial/model number are not clearly readable.

claims.claim: Very clean UK-Used PS4 Pro Console with 10 games and two pads
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not clearly show the PS4 Pro model label, the console serial/model, the 10 games, or the receipt.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No photo of seals/stickers, warranty void marks, or internal inspection.
No temperature/usage test, no gameplay session, no error history shown.
No close-up of ports or demonstration of HDMI/USB/audio working.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows controller boxes, but not the actual controllers themselves, and no receipt is visible/readable.

risks.risk: Console model may not be PS4 Pro (could be standard PS4) or model label not visible
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console rear label showing the exact model (CUH-xxxx) and a photo of the system settings screen (System > System Information).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a standard PS4 (worst case vs PS4 Pro).

risks.risk: Controllers may be missing, not original, or not fully functional (drift/buttons/charging)
risks.proof: Video clip showing both controllers connected and working in-game + a close-up of controller model/label on the back.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (pads/games not guaranteed).

risks.risk: 10 games may not be included, may be digital codes, or may be incomplete/incorrect
risks.proof: A photo spread showing all 10 game cases/discs (or a list with matching photos) laid out clearly.

risks.risk: Ports may have faults (HDMI/USB/audio/Ethernet) or console may have issues under load
risks.proof: Short test video: HDMI to TV showing boot + USB device detection + audio output; ideally a 10–15 minute gameplay clip.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / assume potential port issues (worst case).

risks.risk: “Never opened” claim may be false; thermal paste/repairs could have been done
risks.proof: Photo of warranty/void seals (if any) and a clear close-up of the console exterior for tamper signs; optionally a service sticker photo.

risks.risk: Receipt/UK-used proof may be unavailable or not match the unit
risks.proof: Photo of the UK receipt with the console serial/model visible (or matching serial on the console label).
risks.if_unproven: Price without any proof of origin/warranty.

proof_requests: Clear rear label photo showing the exact PS4 model (CUH-xxxx) and serial number (hide last digits if needed).
Photo of the actual console power-on screen (System > System Information) showing PS4 Pro/firmware.
Photo of all included items: both controllers (actual units), and all 10 games (cases/discs) laid out.
Video test: boot to home screen + HDMI output + at least one USB port + audio working.
Photo of the receipt (and/or matching serial/model) if it truly comes with it.
response.reason: From photo 0, the console model (PS4 Pro vs other) and the included 10 games/receipt are not verifiably shown, and key functionality claims (ports, overheating, never opened) require testing or clear labels. Without those, a safe worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
